summary: Master Agile PMO and Hybrid Project Delivery with practical dashboards, governance models, and release planning. Build hybrid delivery skills for real projects.
lede: An Agile PMO supports project governance and reporting across teams using adaptive and predictive delivery approaches. This training is for PMO professionals, project managers, delivery leads and others working with agile teams who need to tailor oversight to project needs; it covers assessing delivery fit, designing governance cadence and decision rights, and using flow, backlog and earned-value measures to create dashboards and release forecasts.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with projects, PMO routines, or agile teams and need stronger capability in hybrid delivery governance.
prerequisites: You will need a laptop for workshop exercises and spreadsheet or dashboard access for reporting activities. Familiarity with project schedules, simple backlog views, or PMO templates will help, and any existing reporting tools used in your organization can be brought into the exercises subject to validation during the discovery session.
